alt: Four columns: examined in the original code and images, proved formally in Lean 4 and TLA+, historical paired comparisons, checked on real runs.
caption: Four evidence layers with different scope. Historical source/helper controls, native runs and formal models are not interchangeable or independently certified reproductions. Paired comparisons refer to the saved versions; they do not certify newer candidates. The real-agent record covers nine tasks, with seven regraded under both graders and Lean Analysis computed from saved verdicts.
